module "ConstTexture.dsm"

product 0 Material "M_LiConstTexture" backend=Graph
  legacy root ""
  %0 = Reflected[TextureObject](Texture="Path(Engine, \"EngineResources/DefaultTexture\")") : Texture2D @L6:C9 "Noise"
  %1 = Reflected[TextureCoordinate](CoordinateIndex=0) : float2 @L15:C41 "A"
  %2 = Reflected[TextureSample](TextureObject=%0, Coordinates=%1, ClassSpecifier="TextureSample") : [RGB:float3, R:float, G:float, B:float, A:float, RGBA:float4] @L15:C18 "A"
  %3 = Reflected[TextureObject](ClassSpecifier="TextureObject", Texture="Path(Engine, \"EngineResources/DefaultTexture\")") : Texture @L16:C34 "B"
  %4 = Reflected[TextureSample](TextureObject=%3, Coordinates=%1, ClassSpecifier="TextureSample") : [RGB:float3, R:float, G:float, B:float, A:float, RGBA:float4] @L16:C18 "B"
  %5 = Add(%2, %4) : float3 @L17:C17 "Color"
  %6 = MaterialSink(EmissiveColor=%5) @L3:C1
  sink %6
